sentences.en: Don't forget that we'll play a very special acoustic show.
sentences.zh: 别忘了我们将会举行一场非常特别的原声演出。

sentences.en: When was the last time you played an acoustic guitar?
sentences.zh: 你上一次弹原声吉他是什么时候？

sentences.en: An electric guitar doesn't sound the same as an acoustic one.
sentences.zh: 电吉他和原声吉他的声音不一样。

phrases.zh: 原声吉他：指没有电子效果器或拾音器增强音效的吉他。

senses.zh: 原声乐器；不用电传音的乐器
